§a【Tier 3 HV】Beeyonds Home§r
An industrial-scale multiblock apiary for the Beeyonds bee mod.
Structure: built from GT basic machine casing, hardened stone, glass, grass, and obsidian — buildable as early as the HV tier.
Houses and automates management of large numbers of bees, boosting breeding and yield efficiency.
Integrates the bee system into an industrial production line — a key facility for mass-producing honey, wax, and other special products.
§bTwo modes (switch in the parameter panel): §aProduction§b runs up to 4x-energy-tier queens in parallel like an Alveary; §aBreed§b takes 2 parent bees, lets you pick the target species and every trait, and after a 20s cycle outputs a pristine queen or up to 64 drones at 300% yield.
